title: The Robot That Watered Only Half the Beds
central_conflict: the garden robot drove every planned row but left one side of each bed dry
decisive_choice: the spray nozzle pointed inward whenever the robot arm pivoted around a corner
resolution: repositioned the nozzle and checked even water coverage with measuring cups
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the garden robot drove every planned row but left one side of each bed dry before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they repeated its route but the same seedlings remained unwatered; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the spray nozzle pointed inward whenever the robot arm pivoted around a corner; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they repositioned the nozzle and checked even water coverage with measuring cups, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Ribbons That Clung to the Roof
central_conflict: the parade ribbons stuck to the plastic canopy instead of fluttering overhead
decisive_choice: rubbing against the dry plastic canopy had built up static electricity
resolution: replaced the rubbing contact with a grounded mounting strip and tested the ribbons

title: The Stage Lights That Blinked With the Music
central_conflict: the stage lamps flickered each time the drummer struck a loud beat
decisive_choice: speaker vibrations were shaking a loose power connector behind the lighting rack
resolution: stopped the rehearsal and had the crew secure and safely test the connector
